# Quantum Star GHZ Heralding

> Exact one-way heralding of a leaf GHZ state from calibrated pure qubit pairs, with optimal even/odd star protocols and a single-layer honeycomb application.

## Read the result
- [Project overview](README.md): headline result, representative three-link values and project navigation.
- [Scientific account](science/README.md): links to the results by topic.
- [Star model](science/MODEL.md): input promise, allowed controls, success criterion and matched baselines.
- [Exact optimality](science/OPTIMALITY.md): complement symmetry, odd parity, median optimization and three-leaf case.
- [Hub instrument](science/IMPLEMENTATION.md): coherent filters, readout, corrections and resources.
- [Honeycomb application](science/NETWORK.md): independent site reduction, exact threshold and Bell routing.
- [Robustness](science/ROBUSTNESS.md): star and path guarantees under specified errors.

## Verify or study
- [Related work](references/RELATED.md): inherited concentration, percolation and transformation results.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): runnable finite checks and tested domains.
- [Learning guide](learning/README.md): the Watrous anchor and reading sequence.
- [Watrous bridge](learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md): from measurements and entanglement to the star proof.
- [Milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md): 30 stages from Schmidt tools through the lattice and noise model.

The exact optimum is for hub instruments and unitary leaf corrections. The lattice threshold concerns independent hub preparation at one color class and ideal local fusion. A stronger LOCC claim is made only where a cut bound is attained.
